definitions.text: Amazon Web Services, a cloud computing platform that provides on-demand infrastructure and managed services.
examples: The team deploys its application on AWS.
AWS offers services for computing, storage, and networking.

definitions.text: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud, an AWS service for running virtual servers called instances.
examples: The API runs on an EC2 instance.
EC2 lets teams scale server capacity as demand changes.

definitions.text: A serverless compute engine from AWS for running containers without managing virtual servers.
examples: The service runs its containers on AWS Fargate.
Fargate automatically provisions the compute capacity for each task.
